User_Story: As an IT admin, I want to register an asset with a tag, category and condition so that it can be tracked and loaned.
Notes: Prisma domain. Scaffold entity + repo + CRUD use cases. Status enum AVAILABLE/RESERVED/ON_LOAN/MAINTENANCE/RETIRED.

User_Story: As an IT admin, I want to list and filter assets by status and category so that I can see what is available.
Notes: Offset pagination (Prisma). Golden Rule #16 — no cursor.

User_Story: As an IT admin, I want to register a borrower with a department and a max-loans limit so that checkout limits are enforced.
Notes: Prisma domain. activeLoanCount guarded against maxLoans (default 3).

User_Story: As a borrower, I want to request a loan for an available asset so that I can use the equipment.
Notes: Prisma domain. Persist loan REQUESTED. Actor from @CurrentUser (#23).

User_Story: As the system, I want loan checkout to synchronously verify the asset is AVAILABLE before persisting so that I never create a loan for a busy asset.
Notes: ACL — apply sync-cross-service-call skill. IAssetValidator port + HTTP adapter to asset-api-service. getOutboundHeaders() (#24). Golden Rule #14.

User_Story: As the system, I want a LOAN_REQUESTED event to reserve the asset asynchronously so that concurrent requests cannot double-book it.
Notes: Saga step 1 — apply choreography-saga skill. loan publishes LOAN_REQUESTED; asset-event-handler runs ReserveAssetUseCase; replies ASSET_RESERVED | ASSET_UNAVAILABLE. Idempotent.

User_Story: As the system, I want the loan to resolve to ACTIVE or REJECTED when the asset reply arrives so that the borrower gets a final answer.
Notes: Saga step 2. loan-event-handler consumes ASSET_RESERVED/ASSET_UNAVAILABLE; transitions REQUESTED->ACTIVE (set checkoutAt) | REJECTED. Replay = no-op.

User_Story: As a borrower, I want to return a loan so that the asset becomes available for others.
Notes: POST /loans/:id/return publishes LOAN_RETURNED; asset handler flips asset back to AVAILABLE. Idempotent.

User_Story: As an IT admin, I want a webapp page to browse and manage assets with status badges so that I can administer the catalogue.
Notes: Thin-orchestrator page + data-table + status-variants.ts. data-testid: assets-table.

User_Story: As a borrower, I want a webapp screen to browse available assets and request a loan so that I can self-serve.
Notes: Form via react-hook-form + Zod from @old-st/contracts/loan. Client hooks in client-common.

User_Story: As an IT admin, I want to see all active and overdue loans in a table so that I can chase returns.
Notes: Filter by status. OVERDUE derived from dueAt.

User_Story: As a borrower, I want a mobile screen to scan and request an asset loan on the go so that I can borrow from the equipment room.
Notes: Reuses client-common hooks. Expo screen + form. Note: + mobile.
